decisions.rationale: A single task root/source_root keeps the worktree, registration, Guard and validator aligned without relaxing the Guard to '.' or relying on string-only matching.
decisions.statement: The disposable task root is the contract source_root; allowed_paths is exactly 'project'; the launcher, Guard, registration and validator all use that source_root-relative path.

decisions.rationale: Binding the expected HEAD outside the contract content avoids a self-referential commit hash cycle while keeping the acceptance expected value trusted.
decisions.statement: The expected task commit is bound after the task commit by a root-owned PREP-BINDING.json under the trusted contract package; the contract does not embed its own commit SHA.

feature.summary: Authorize one disposable worktree and its EVIDENCE.txt for a deterministic read-only sandbox check.
feature.title: Bridge read-only acceptance task

read_first.why: confirm the disposable worktree identity without a broad scan

requirements.statement: The task must run only read-only identity, path, git and OS commands in the disposable worktree and write their raw output to `EVIDENCE.txt`.

scope: Read-only inspection of the disposable task worktree
Write only EVIDENCE.txt inside that worktree
Return the real sandbox execution outcome
stop_conditions: Any write outside the disposable worktree: STOP, CONTRACT_DEVIATION.
Any synthesized or missing evidence: STOP, EVIDENCE_MISSING.
Any formal source, contract, compiler, guard, launcher, profile or host change: STOP, ABSOLUTE_BLOCK_VIOLATION.

tasks.boundary: Read-only inspection and one evidence file only. No formal source or host change.
tasks.done_when: EVIDENCE.txt is present in the worktree with exactly the four labeled actual values and the bridge reports its real process outcome; process exit does not by itself prove task acceptance.
tasks.goal: Run `id -un`, `pwd`, `git rev-parse HEAD` and `uname -s` in `/var/tmp/BRIDGE-READONLY-001/project`; write exactly four labeled lines to `EVIDENCE.txt` in this order: `id -un: <actual>`, `pwd: <actual>`, `git rev-parse HEAD: <actual>`, `uname -s: <actual>`; no other lines or files.
verification: EVIDENCE.txt` in the worktree contains exactly four labeled lines whose values are `aegl-ai
and `Linux`; compare with the actual command results; no other file changed.

cli_checks.on_failure: stop; record the actual command, exit code and output; do not synthesize EVIDENCE.txt
stop; record the actual value; do not synthesize EVIDENCE.txt

cli_checks.expected: the frozen task commit recorded in PREP-BINDING.json under the trusted contract package; the contract must not embed its own commit SHA
cli_checks.on_failure: stop; record the actual command, exit code and output; do not synthesize EVIDENCE.txt
stop; record the actual value; do not synthesize EVIDENCE.txt

cli_checks.expected: exactly four labeled lines in this order, with no extra lines: `id -un: aegl-ai`, `pwd: /var/tmp/BRIDGE-READONLY-001/project`, `git rev-parse HEAD: <PREP-BINDING.json commit>`, `uname -s: Linux`
cli_checks.on_failure: stop; record the failure; do not synthesize or repair EVIDENCE.txt

verification_intent.fixture_intent: The disposable task root /var/tmp/BRIDGE-READONLY-001 with worktree project/; the trusted PREP-BINDING.json binds the expected task commit after the commit exists.
verification_intent.oracle_intent: Deterministic CLI evidence: actual command outputs in exactly four labeled EVIDENCE.txt lines, checked against the trusted PREP-BINDING.json; no synthesized value, no formal write, no promotion.
persistence_checks: EVIDENCE.txt persists in the task worktree (contract path project/EVIDENCE.txt) with exactly four labeled lines
search_checks: EVIDENCE.txt contains the exact values aegl-ai, /var/tmp/BRIDGE-READONLY-001/project, the PREP-BINDING.json commit and Linux
